  const openDelete = (summary: CaseSummary): void => {
    const target = activeRepository;
    if (target === null) {
      return;
    }

    void target
      .getCaseDeletionPreview(summary.id)
      .then((preview) => {
        if (preview === null) {
          setFeedback({
            message: `That case is already gone: ${summary.title}.`,
            tone: 'info',
          });
          void refreshFromRemote();
          return;
        }
        setDeletePreview(preview);
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setFeedback({
          message: 'The case contents could not be read. Nothing was deleted.',
          tone: 'error',
        });
      });
  };

  const handleRetry = (): void => {
    focusAfterLoadRef.current = true;
    setStatus('loading');
    setActiveRepository(null);
    setReloadToken((token) => token + 1);
  };

  const openImportBackup = (): void => {
    setBackupState({ view: 'import' });
  };

  const openExportBackup = (summary: CaseSummary): void => {
    setBackupState({ view: 'export', summary });
  };

  const handleImported = (result: RestoreCaseResult): void => {
    remoteRefreshTokenRef.current += 1;
    setSelectedCaseId(result.caseId);
    setFeedback({ message: `Case restored: ${result.title}.`, tone: 'success' });
    void refreshFromRemote();
  };

  const handleExported = (result: ExportCaseResult): void => {
    const target = activeRepository;
    if (target === null) {
      return;
    }

    void persistBackupPromptedAt(target, result.archive.manifest.case.id)
      .then(() => {
        setFeedback({ message: `Backup saved: ${result.save.fileName}.`, tone: 'success' });
        void refreshFromRemote();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        setFeedback({
          message:
            'The backup file was saved, but the backup reminder could not be updated. The case is unchanged.',
          tone: 'error',
        });
      });
  };

  const applySummary = (summary: CaseSummary | null): boolean => {
    if (summary === null) {
      // The write is already committed but the authoritative summary could not
      // be read. Show the recoverable shelf error instead of a stale tile.
      setStatus('error');
      setActiveRepository(null);
      return false;
    }

    setCases((current) =>
      orderCases([...current.filter((item) => item.id !== summary.id), summary]),
    );
    return true;
  };

  const handleCreate = async (
    target: CaseRepositoryPort,
    values: CaseFormValues,
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const wasFirstCase = cases.length === 0;
    const record = await target.createCase({
      title: values.title,
      ...(values.subject !== null ? { subject: values.subject } : {}),
      ...(values.examDate !== null ? { examDate: values.examDate } : {}),
    });

    // Cancel any remote refresh that read before this commit: the local
    // summary below is now the newer persisted truth for this tab.
    remoteRefreshTokenRef.current += 1;
    broadcastMutation(record.id, 'created');
    if (wasFirstCase) {
      requestPersistenceForFirstCase();
    }

    const summary = await target.getCaseSummary(record.id).catch(() => null);

    if (!applySummary(summary)) {
      setFeedback({
        message: 'The case was created, but the shelf could not refresh. Retry to see it.',
        tone: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSelectedCaseId(record.id);
    pendingFocusCaseIdRef.current = record.id;
    setFeedback({ message: `Case created: ${record.title}.`, tone: 'success' });
  };

  const handleUpdate = async (
    target: CaseRepositoryPort,
    summaryId: string,
    values: CaseFormValues,
  ): Promise<void> => {
    const updated = await target.updateCase(summaryId, {
      title: values.title,
      subject: values.subject,
      examDate: values.examDate,
    });

    remoteRefreshTokenRef.current += 1;
    broadcastMutation(updated.id, 'updated');

    const summary = await target.getCaseSummary(updated.id).catch(() => null);

    if (!applySummary(summary)) {
      setFeedback({
        message: 'The case was saved, but the shelf could not refresh. Retry to see it.',
        tone: 'error',
      });
      return;
    }

    setSelectedCaseId(updated.id);
    setFeedback({ message: `Case updated: ${updated.title}.`, tone: 'success' });
  };

  /**
   * Called only by the confirmed dialog. The repository commits the cascade in
   * one transaction; this handler updates derived shelf state afterwards.
   */
  const handleDeleteConfirmed = async (): Promise<void> => {
    const target = activeRepository;
    const preview = deletePreview;

    if (target === null || preview === null) {
      throw new Error('The case repository is not open.');
    }

    const deleted = await target.deleteCase(preview.caseId);

    remoteRefreshTokenRef.current += 1;
    broadcastMutation(preview.caseId, 'deleted');
    setCases((current) => current.filter((summary) => summary.id !== preview.caseId));
    setSelectedCaseId((current) => (current === preview.caseId ? null : current));
    setDeletePreview(null);

    setFeedback({
      message: deleted
        ? `Case deleted: ${preview.title}.`
        : `The case was already deleted: ${preview.title}.`,
      tone: 'success',
    });
  };

  const handleDialogSubmit = async (values: CaseFormValues): Promise<void> => {
    if (dialog === null) {
      return;
    }

    const target = activeRepository;
    if (target === null) {
      throw new Error('The case repository is not open.');
    }

    if (dialog.mode === 'edit') {
      await handleUpdate(target, dialog.summary.id, values);
      return;
    }

    await handleCreate(target, values);
  };

  const storageStatus =
    status === 'ready' ? (
      <StorageStatus persistence={persistence} estimate={storageEstimate} />
    ) : null;

  return (
    <section className="shelf" aria-labelledby="shelf-title" aria-busy={status === 'loading'}>
      <header className="shelf__header">
        <div className="shelf__heading">
          <p className="shelf__eyebrow">Case files</p>
          <h2 id="shelf-title" ref={headingRef} tabIndex={-1}>

          <p className="shelf__intro">

            one.
          </p>
        </div>

        {status === 'ready' && cases.length > 0 ? (
          <Button variant="primary" size="lg" onClick={openCreate}>
            New case
          </Button>
        ) : null}
      </header>

      <Toast
        message={feedback?.message ?? null}

      />

      {status === 'loading' ? (

        </p>
      ) : null}

      {status === 'error' ? (
        <section className="shelf__error" role="alert" aria-labelledby="shelf-error-title">
          <h3 id="shelf-error-title">Case shelf could not open</h3>

  readonly onDelete: (summary: CaseSummary) => void;

export interface DeleteCaseDialogProps {
  /** Authoritative counts read from storage when the dialog opened. */
  readonly preview: CaseDeletionPreview;
  readonly onClose: () => void;
  /**
   * Performs the cascade. A rejection keeps the dialog open and announces that
   * nothing was removed; the transaction rolls back in the data layer.
   */
  readonly onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
}

type CountKey = 'cards' | 'connections' | 'images';

function countRows(
  preview: CaseDeletionPreview,
): { key: CountKey; label: string; value: number }[] {
  return [
    { key: 'cards', label: 'Cards', value: preview.cardCount },
    { key: 'connections', label: 'Connections', value: preview.connectionCount },
    { key: 'images', label: 'Images', value: preview.imageCount },
  ];
}

/**
 * Destructive confirmation for deleting a whole case.
 *
 * It names the case, states the exact card, connection, and image counts, and
 * says plainly that deletion is permanent. Cancel receives initial focus so a
 * keyboard user cannot destroy a case by reflex, Escape cancels, and the shared
 * Dialog restores focus to the delete trigger on close. There is deliberately
 * no undo control.
 */
export default function DeleteCaseDialog({ preview, onClose, onConfirm }: DeleteCaseDialogProps) {
  const [deleting, setDeleting] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const cancelRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);

  const handleConfirm = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (deleting) {
      return;
    }

    setDeleting(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      await onConfirm();
      onClose();
    } catch {
      // The data layer rolled the whole transaction back. Keep the dialog and
      // its counts so the student can retry or cancel.
      setError('The case could not be deleted. Nothing was removed; try again.');
      setDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog
      open
      onClose={onClose}
      title={`Delete “${preview.title}”?`}
      description="Deleting a case permanently removes it and everything pinned to it from this device."
      size="sm"
      dismissible={!deleting}
      closeOnBackdrop={!deleting}
      initialFocusRef={cancelRef}
      actions={
        <>
          <Button ref={cancelRef} variant="quiet" onClick={onClose} disabled={deleting}>
            Cancel
          </Button>
          <Button variant="danger" onClick={() => void handleConfirm()} disabled={deleting}>
            {deleting ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete case'}
          </Button>
        </>
      }
    >
      <div className="delete-case">
        <p className="delete-case__lead">This removes the case and everything stored in it:</p>

        <dl className="delete-case__counts" aria-label="Case contents">
          {countRows(preview).map((row) => (
            <div key={row.key} className="delete-case__count" data-count={row.key}>
              <dt>{row.label}</dt>
              <dd>{row.value}</dd>
            </div>
          ))}
        </dl>

        <p className="delete-case__warning" role="note">
          <strong>Deletion is permanent.</strong> It cannot be undone and no copy is kept in the
          app.
        </p>

        {error !== null ? (
          <p className="delete-case__error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        ) : null}
      </div>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

import Dexie, { type EntityTable } from 'dexie';

import type { AttachmentRecord, CardRecord, CaseRecord, ConnectionRecord } from '../domain/model';

/**
 * Version 1 of the local case database.
 *
 * The persisted row shapes are the validated domain records: every field is
 * JSON-safe except the attachment Blob, which IndexedDB stores structurally.
 * Mappers in `mappers.ts` are the only place that translates a raw row.
 */

export const DATABASE_NAME = 'notes-detective';
export const DATABASE_VERSION = 1;

export type CaseRow = CaseRecord;
export type CardRow = CardRecord;
export type ConnectionRow = ConnectionRecord;
export type AttachmentRow = AttachmentRecord;

/**
 * Indexes are chosen from the shelf and board read paths:
 *
 * - cases: newest-first shelf scans and nearest-exam-date sorting.
 * - cards: one case at a time plus the type filter used by the board and search.
 * - connections: one case at a time plus the canonical pair uniqueness rule.
 *   `pairKey` is globally unique because every card id is unique, so `&pairKey`
 *   also protects against a cross-case pair being written twice.
 * - attachments: every Blob for a card and one row per kind.
 */
export class NotesDetectiveDatabase extends Dexie {
  cases!: EntityTable<CaseRow, 'id'>;
  cards!: EntityTable<CardRow, 'id'>;
  connections!: EntityTable<ConnectionRow, 'id'>;
  attachments!: EntityTable<AttachmentRow, 'id'>;

  constructor(name: string = DATABASE_NAME) {
    super(name);

    this.version(DATABASE_VERSION).stores({
      cases: 'id, updatedAt, examDate',
      cards: 'id, caseId, [caseId+type]',
      connections: 'id, caseId, &pairKey, &[caseId+pairKey], fromCardId, toCardId',
      attachments: 'id, cardId, [cardId+kind]',
    });
  }
}

/**
 * Create a database handle without opening it. Callers own the handle so tests
 * can use isolated names and the app can create a single long-lived instance.
 */
export function createNotesDetectiveDatabase(name: string = DATABASE_NAME): NotesDetectiveDatabase {
  return new NotesDetectiveDatabase(name);
}

/** Open a handle and wait for the version upgrade to finish. */
export async function openNotesDetectiveDatabase(
  name: string = DATABASE_NAME,
): Promise<NotesDetectiveDatabase> {
  const db = new NotesDetectiveDatabase(name);
  await db.open();
  return db;
}

type BoardCardPosition = { readonly id: string; readonly x: number; readonly y: number };
type StoredCard = {
  readonly id: string;
  readonly caseId: string;
  readonly title: string;
  readonly position: { readonly x: number; readonly y: number };
};

async function readCards(page: Page): Promise<StoredCard[]> {
  return page.evaluate(async () => {
    const database = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolvePromise, reject) => {
      const request = indexedDB.open('notes-detective');
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolvePromise(request.result);
    });

    const rows = await new Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]>((resolvePromise, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction('cards', 'readonly');
      const request = transaction.objectStore('cards').getAll();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolvePromise(request.result as Record<string, unknown>[]);
    });

    database.close();

    return rows.map((row) => {
      const position = row.position as { x?: unknown; y?: unknown } | undefined;
      return {
        id: String(row.id),
        caseId: String(row.caseId),
        title: String(row.title),
        position: {
          x: Number(position?.x ?? 0),
          y: Number(position?.y ?? 0),
        },
      };
    });
  });
}

async function readCard(page: Page, caseId: string): Promise<StoredCard> {
  const rows = await readCards(page);
  const found = rows.find((row) => row.caseId === caseId);
  if (found === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`No card was found for case ${caseId}`);
  }
  return found;

    });
    const rows = await new Promise<Record<string, unknown>[]>((resolvePromise, reject) => {
      const transaction = database.transaction('cases', 'readonly');
      const request = transaction.objectStore('cases').getAll();
      request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);
      request.onsuccess = () => resolvePromise(request.result as Record<string, unknown>[]);
    });
    database.close();
    const id = rows[0]?.id;
    if (id === undefined) {
      throw new Error('The created case was not persisted');
    }
    return String(id);
  });

  return caseId;
}

async function addTopic(page: Page, caseId: string): Promise<void> {
  await page.goto(`/#/case/${caseId}/capture`);

  await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Add topic' }).click();

  await expect(page.getByTestId('board-canvas')).toHaveAttribute(

  await expect(page.getByTestId('board-canvas')).toHaveAttribute('data-board-card-count', '1');

/** The screen point over a card's upper-left region. */
async function cardPoint(page: Page, cardId: string): Promise<{ x: number; y: number }> {
  const host = page.getByTestId('board-canvas-host');
  const box = await host.boundingBox();
  if (box === null) {
    throw new Error('The board canvas host did not render');
  }

  const [viewport, cards] = await Promise.all([readBoardViewport(page), readBoardCards(page)]);
  const card = cards.find((candidate) => candidate.id === cardId);
  if (card === undefined) {
    throw new Error(`Card ${cardId} is missing from the board snapshot`);
  }

  // Forty pixels in from the top-left stays inside a 240 x 320 card and keeps
  // the point visible even when a drag moved the card near the viewport edge.
  return {
    x: box.x + (card.x + 40 - viewport.x) * viewport.scale,
    y: box.y + (card.y + 40 - viewport.y) * viewport.scale,
  };
}

async function dispatchTouch(
  page: Page,
  type: 'pointerdown' | 'pointermove' | 'pointerup',
  point: { readonly x: number; readonly y: number },
  pointerId: number,
): Promise<void> {
  await page.evaluate(
    ({ eventType, x, y, id }) => {
      const host = document.querySelector('[data-testid="board-canvas-host"]');
      if (!(host instanceof HTMLElement)) {
        throw new Error('The board host is missing');
      }

      host.dispatchEvent(
        new PointerEvent(eventType, {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true,
          pointerId: id,
          pointerType: 'touch',
          isPrimary: true,
          button: 0,
          buttons: eventType === 'pointerup' ? 0 : 1,
          clientX: x,
          clientY: y,
        }),
      );
    },
    { eventType: type, x: point.x, y: point.y, id: pointerId },
  );
}

test('drags a card with the mouse and persists its position across reload', async ({ page }) => {
  test.setTimeout(60_000);
  const consoleErrors: string[] = [];
  page.on('console', (message) => {
    if (message.type() === 'error') {
      consoleErrors.push(message.text());
    }
  });

  const caseId = await createCase(page);
  await addTopic(page, caseId);

  const before = await readCard(page, caseId);

  // A click without movement is a tap and opens card detail. Do this while the
  // card is fully visible, before the drag moves it toward the viewport edge.
  const clickPoint = await cardPoint(page, before.id);
  await page.mouse.click(clickPoint.x, clickPoint.y);
  await expect(page).toHaveURL(new RegExp(`/case/${caseId}/card/${before.id}`));
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 2, name: TOPIC_TITLE })).toBeVisible({
    timeout: 20_000,
  });

  await page.goBack();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('board-canvas')).toHaveAttribute(
    'data-board-scene-status',
    'ready',
    { timeout: 20_000 },
  );

  const start = await cardPoint(page, before.id);
  await page.mouse.move(start.x, start.y);
  await page.mouse.down();
  await page.mouse.move(start.x + 150, start.y + 80, { steps: 8 });
  await page.mouse.up();

  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await readBoardCards(page))[0]?.x ?? Number.NaN, { timeout: 5_000 })
    .toBeGreaterThan(before.position.x + 80);

  const live = (await readBoardCards(page))[0];
  if (live === undefined) {
    throw new Error('The dragged card disappeared from the board snapshot');
  }
  expect(live.y).toBeGreaterThan(before.position.y + 30);

  // The page waits 300 ms after drop before it writes. The final position must
  // reach IndexedDB and survive a full reload.
  await page.waitForTimeout(800);
  const stored = await readCard(page, caseId);
  expect(stored.position.x).toBeCloseTo(live.x, 0);
  expect(stored.position.y).toBeCloseTo(live.y, 0);

  await page.reload();
  await expect(page.getByRole('heading', { level: 2, name: 'Case board' })).toBeVisible();
  await expect(page.getByTestId('board-canvas')).toHaveAttribute(
    'data-board-scene-status',
    'ready',
    { timeout: 20_000 },
  );

  await expect
    .poll(async () => (await readBoardCards(page))[0]?.x ?? Number.NaN, { timeout: 10_000 })
    .toBeCloseTo(stored.position.x, 0);

  const afterReload = (await readBoardCards(page))[0];
  expect(afterReload?.y ?? Number.NaN).toBeCloseTo(stored.position.y, 0);
  expect(afterReload?.id).toBe(before.id);

  expect(consoleErrors).toEqual([]);
});

import { lazy, Suspense } from 'react';
import { Route, Routes, useLocation } from 'react-router';

import type { CaseRepositoryPort } from '../data/caseRepository';
import type { CardDetailRepositoryLoader } from '../features/cards/CardDetailPage';
import type { CaseBoardRepositoryLoader } from '../features/case/CaseBoardPage';
import type { CaptureRepositoryLoader } from '../features/capture/CapturePage';
import type { CaseRepositoryLoader } from '../features/shelf/CaseShelfPage';

import ErrorBoundary from './ErrorBoundary';

const ShelfScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('../features/shelf/CaseShelfPage').then((module) => ({
    default: module.CaseShelfPage,
  })),
);
const CaseBoardScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('../features/case/CaseBoardPage').then((module) => ({
    default: module.CaseBoardPage,
  })),
);
const CaptureScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('../features/capture/CapturePage').then((module) => ({
    default: module.CapturePage,
  })),
);
const CardDetailScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('../features/cards/CardDetailPage').then((module) => ({
    default: module.CardDetailPage,
  })),
);
const RecallScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('./placeholders').then((module) => ({ default: module.RecallPlaceholder })),
);
const SettingsScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('./placeholders').then((module) => ({ default: module.SettingsPlaceholder })),
);
const NotFoundScreen = lazy(() =>
  import('./placeholders').then((module) => ({ default: module.NotFoundPlaceholder })),
);

export interface AppRoutesProps {
  /** Replaces the shelf's repository in tests and future composition. */
  readonly shelfRepository?: CaseRepositoryPort | undefined;
  /** Replaces the shelf's repository opener, including its failure path. */
  readonly loadShelfRepository?: CaseRepositoryLoader | undefined;
  /** Replaces the capture route's repository in tests and future composition. */
  readonly captureRepository?: CaseRepositoryPort | undefined;
  /** Replaces the capture route's repository opener, including its failure path. */
  readonly loadCaptureRepository?: CaptureRepositoryLoader | undefined;
  /** Replaces the card-detail route's repository in tests and future composition. */
  readonly cardRepository?: CaseRepositoryPort | undefined;
  /** Replaces the card-detail route's repository opener, including its failure path. */
  readonly loadCardRepository?: CardDetailRepositoryLoader | undefined;
  /** Replaces the board route's repository in tests and future composition. */
  readonly boardRepository?: CaseRepositoryPort | undefined;
  /** Replaces the board route's repository opener, including its failure path. */
  readonly loadBoardRepository?: CaseBoardRepositoryLoader | undefined;
}

/**
 * The only route table in the app. Every feature screen is loaded lazily and
 * every route sits inside a boundary keyed by location, so recovering to the
 * shelf remounts the view instead of leaving the boundary latched.
 */
export function AppRoutes({
  shelfRepository,
  loadShelfRepository,
  captureRepository,
  loadCaptureRepository,
  cardRepository,
  loadCardRepository,
  boardRepository,
  loadBoardRepository,
}: AppRoutesProps = {}) {
  const location = useLocation();

  return (
    <ErrorBoundary resetKey={location.key}>
      <Suspense
        fallback={
          <p className="route-loading" aria-live="polite">
            Opening the case file…
          </p>
        }
      >
        <Routes>
          <Route
            path="/"
            element={
              <ShelfScreen repository={shelfRepository} loadRepository={loadShelfRepository} />
            }
          />
          <Route
            path="/case/:caseId"
            element={
              <CaseBoardScreen repository={boardRepository} loadRepository={loadBoardRepository} />
            }
          />
          <Route
            path="/case/:caseId/card/:cardId"
            element={
              <CardDetailScreen repository={cardRepository} loadRepository={loadCardRepository} />
            }
          />
          <Route
            path="/case/:caseId/capture"
            element={
              <CaptureScreen
                repository={captureRepository}
                loadRepository={loadCaptureRepository}
              />
            }
          />
          <Route path="/case/:caseId/recall" element={<RecallScreen />} />
          <Route path="/settings" element={<SettingsScreen />} />
          <Route path="*" element={<NotFoundScreen />} />
        </Routes>
      </Suspense>
    </ErrorBoundary>
  );
}

export default AppRoutes;

  readonly fileName: string;

export type ArchiveExportStage = 'reading' | 'hashing' | 'packaging';

/** A typed export failure so the UI can name the stage that failed. */
export class ArchiveExportError extends Error {
  readonly stage: ArchiveExportStage;
  readonly cause: unknown;

  constructor(stage: ArchiveExportStage, message: string, cause?: unknown) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ArchiveExportError';
    this.stage = stage;
    this.cause = cause;

function assertDigest(value: string): string {
  if (!/^[0-9a-f]{64}$/.test(value)) {
    throw new ArchiveExportError(
      'hashing',
      'An image could not be verified because its SHA-256 digest was invalid.',

  }
  return value;
}

async function readBlobBytes(attachmentId: string, blob: Blob): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  try {
    return new Uint8Array(await blob.arrayBuffer());
  } catch (cause) {
    throw new ArchiveExportError(
      'reading',
      `Image attachment "${attachmentId}" could not be read from device storage.`,
      cause,
    );
  }

 * string that belongs to another case fails manifest validation rather than

export async function buildCaseArchive(input: BuildCaseArchiveInput): Promise<CaseArchive> {

  if (caseRecord === null) {

    repository.listCards(caseId),
    repository.listConnections(caseId),

    cards.map(async (card) => ({
      cardId: card.id,
      attachments: await repository.listAttachments(card.id),

  );

          'reading',
          `Attachment "${attachment.id}" does not belong to card "${cardId}".`,

      try {
        sha256 = assertDigest(await digest(attachment.blob));

        if (cause instanceof ArchiveExportError) {
          throw cause;
        }
        throw new ArchiveExportError(
          'hashing',
          `Image attachment "${attachment.id}" could not be verified.`,
          cause,
        );

          'packaging',

      caseRecord,

    if (cause instanceof DomainValidationError) {

      'packaging',

    }

    bytes,
    blob: new Blob([bytes], { type: ARCHIVE_MIME_TYPE }),
    manifest,

      ? resolveShowSaveFilePicker()

        types: [

      method: 'file-system-access',

      throw cause;

type CaseDependents = {
  readonly cardIds: readonly string[];
  readonly connectionIds: readonly string[];
  readonly attachmentIds: readonly string[];
};

/**
 * Select every row owned by a case for the replace cascade. Children are not
 * schema-validated here for the same reason as `deleteCase`: a malformed child
 * must be removable instead of trapping the case forever. The target case row
 * itself is validated by the caller.
 */
async function readCaseDependents(
  db: NotesDetectiveDatabase,
  caseId: string,
): Promise<CaseDependents> {
  const cardRows = await db.cards.where('caseId').equals(caseId).toArray();
  const cardIds = cardRows.map((row) => row.id);

  const caseConnections = await db.connections.where('caseId').equals(caseId).toArray();
  const endpointConnections =
    cardIds.length === 0
      ? []
      : [
          ...(await db.connections.where('fromCardId').anyOf(cardIds).toArray()),
          ...(await db.connections.where('toCardId').anyOf(cardIds).toArray()),
        ];
  const connectionIds = [
    ...new Set([...caseConnections, ...endpointConnections].map((row) => row.id)),
  ];

  const attachmentRows =
    cardIds.length === 0 ? [] : await db.attachments.where('cardId').anyOf(cardIds).toArray();

  return {
    cardIds,
    connectionIds,
    attachmentIds: attachmentRows.map((row) => row.id),
  };
}

  input: CaseArchiveInput,
  options: ImportCaseOptions,

    ...(options.supportedDbSchemaVersions !== undefined
      ? { supportedDbSchemaVersions: options.supportedDbSchemaVersions }

/**
 * Initial card placement for a new capture.
 *
 * The case board's persisted viewport names the world coordinate of the
 * visible top-left corner at the saved scale. A new card therefore lands in the
 * middle of what the student could see, with a small diagonal stagger so two
 * saves in a row do not stack exactly on top of each other.
 *
 * This helper is deliberately pure: it has no DOM, storage, or Pixi dependency
 * and can be exercised without a browser.
 */

import type { CardPosition, Viewport } from '../../domain/model';

export type CaptureViewportSize = {
  readonly width: number;
  readonly height: number;
};

/** Distance between staggered card saves, in world pixels. */
export const INITIAL_CARD_STAGGER_PX = 16;

/** Repeat the stagger after this many cards so it never drifts far away. */
export const INITIAL_CARD_STAGGER_CYCLE = 6;

function finitePositive(value: number, fallback: number): number {
  return Number.isFinite(value) && value > 0 ? value : fallback;
}

/**
 * Convert the saved viewport plus the current visible size into a world
 * position near the middle of the screen. Coordinates stay nonnegative because
 * that is the domain contract for a card position.
 */
export function computeInitialCardPosition(
  viewport: Viewport,
  viewportSize: CaptureViewportSize,
  existingCardCount: number,
): CardPosition {
  const scale = finitePositive(viewport.scale, 1);
  const width = finitePositive(viewportSize.width, 1);
  const height = finitePositive(viewportSize.height, 1);
  const count = Number.isFinite(existingCardCount) ? Math.max(0, Math.trunc(existingCardCount)) : 0;
  const stagger = (count % INITIAL_CARD_STAGGER_CYCLE) * INITIAL_CARD_STAGGER_PX;

  return {
    x: Math.max(0, Math.round(viewport.x + width / (2 * scale) + stagger)),
    y: Math.max(0, Math.round(viewport.y + height / (2 * scale) + stagger)),
  };
}

/**
 * Read the browser's visible content area. The capture route fills the main
 * landmark, so its measured box is the closest honest equivalent of the board's
 * visible region; window dimensions are the fallback when it is not mounted.
 * Tests inject their own reader to keep placement deterministic.
 */
export function readBrowserViewportSize(): CaptureViewportSize {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') {
    return { width: 1, height: 1 };
  }

  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
    const main = document.getElementById('main-content');
    const rect = main?.getBoundingClientRect();
    if (rect !== undefined && rect.width > 0 && rect.height > 0) {
      return { width: rect.width, height: rect.height };
    }
  }

  return {
    width: finitePositive(window.innerWidth, 1),
    height: finitePositive(window.innerHeight, 1),
  };
}

export function normalizeTag(tag: string): string {
  const normalized = tag.trim();
  if (normalized.length === 0) {

 * Rejects an eleventh distinct tag instead of silently dropping user input.
 */
export function normalizeTags(tags: readonly string[]): string[] {
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  const normalizedTags: string[] = [];

  for (const tag of tags) {
    const normalized = normalizeTag(tag);
    const key = normalized.toLowerCase();
    if (seen.has(key)) {
      continue;
    }
    seen.add(key);
    normalizedTags.push(normalized);
  }

  if (normalizedTags.length > MAX_TAGS) {
    throw new DomainValidationError(`Invalid tags: at most ${MAX_TAGS} distinct tags are allowed`, [
      domainIssue(['tags'], `At most ${MAX_TAGS} distinct tags are allowed`),
    ]);
  }

  return normalizedTags;
}

function parseRgb(color: string): Rgb {
  const match = /rgba?\(\s*([\d.]+)[,\s]+([\d.]+)[,\s]+([\d.]+)/i.exec(color);
  if (!match) {

export type ConnectionEndpointCard = Pick<CardRecord, 'id' | 'caseId' | 'type'>;

/**
 * Validate a connection against the cards of its case: both endpoints exist,
 * belong to the same case, are distinct, use the canonical pair key, and obey
 * the provenance rule. This is the pure half of the repository boundary.
 */
export function assertConnectionInCase(
  connection: Pick<ConnectionRecord, 'caseId' | 'fromCardId' | 'toCardId' | 'pairKey' | 'type'>,
  cards: readonly ConnectionEndpointCard[],
): void {
  const issues: ZodIssue[] = [];
  const byId = new Map(cards.map((card) => [card.id, card] as const));
  const fromCard = byId.get(connection.fromCardId);
  const toCard = byId.get(connection.toCardId);

  if (fromCard === undefined) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['fromCardId'], 'Connection endpoint does not exist in this case'));
  } else if (fromCard.caseId !== connection.caseId) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['fromCardId'], 'Connection endpoint belongs to another case'));
  }

  if (toCard === undefined) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['toCardId'], 'Connection endpoint does not exist in this case'));
  } else if (toCard.caseId !== connection.caseId) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['toCardId'], 'Connection endpoint belongs to another case'));
  }

  if (connection.fromCardId === connection.toCardId) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['toCardId'], 'A connection cannot link a card to itself'));
  }

  const expectedPairKey = buildPairKey(connection.fromCardId, connection.toCardId);
  if (connection.pairKey !== expectedPairKey) {
    issues.push(domainIssue(['pairKey'], `Expected the canonical pair key "${expectedPairKey}"`));
  }

  if (
    fromCard !== undefined &&
    toCard !== undefined &&
    fromCard.caseId === connection.caseId &&
    toCard.caseId === connection.caseId &&
    connection.type === 'provenance' &&
    !isProvenanceEligible(fromCard.type, toCard.type)
  ) {
    issues.push(
      domainIssue(['type'], 'Provenance is legal only between one Study Note and one Source'),
    );
  }

  throwIfIssues(issues, 'Connection is not valid for this case');
}

import type { MouseEvent, ReactNode } from 'react';
import { NavLink } from 'react-router';

import OfflineNotice from './OfflineNotice';
import './AppShell.css';

interface AppShellProps {
  readonly children: ReactNode;
  /** Optional storage or persistence state supplied by a feature owner. */
  readonly storageStatus?: ReactNode;
}

/**
 * The shared frame every route renders inside: compact top bar, status slot,
 * skip link, and the single main landmark.
 */
export default function AppShell({ children, storageStatus }: AppShellProps) {
  const handleSkip = (event: MouseEvent<HTMLAnchorElement>): void => {
    // HashRouter owns window.location.hash, so a raw fragment navigation would
    // be read as a route change. Focus the landmark directly instead.
    event.preventDefault();
    document.getElementById('main-content')?.focus();
  };

  return (
    <div className="app-frame">
      <a className="app-frame__skip-link" href="#main-content" onClick={handleSkip}>
        Skip to content
      </a>

      <header className="app-frame__topbar">
        <h1 className="app-frame__title">Notes Detective</h1>
        <nav className="app-frame__nav" aria-label="Primary">
          <NavLink to="/" end>
            Case shelf
          </NavLink>
          <NavLink to="/settings">Settings</NavLink>
        </nav>
      </header>

      <div className="app-frame__status">
        <OfflineNotice />
        {storageStatus}
      </div>

      <main id="main-content" className="app-frame__content" tabIndex={-1}>
        {children}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { registerSW } from 'virtual:pwa-register';

export interface UpdatePromptState {
  readonly needRefresh: boolean;
  readonly blockedByUnsavedChanges: boolean;
}

type UpdatePromptListener = () => void;
type UpdateServiceWorker = (reloadPage?: boolean) => Promise<void>;

let updateServiceWorker: UpdateServiceWorker | null = null;
let registrationStarted = false;
let needRefresh = false;
let unsavedChanges = false;
let snapshot: UpdatePromptState = Object.freeze({
  needRefresh: false,
  blockedByUnsavedChanges: false,
});

const listeners = new Set<UpdatePromptListener>();

function publish(): void {
  snapshot = Object.freeze({
    needRefresh,
    blockedByUnsavedChanges: needRefresh && unsavedChanges,
  });

  for (const listener of listeners) {
    listener();
  }
}

/**
 * Registers the generated service worker in prompt mode. The waiting worker is
 * never activated here: only `confirmUpdate()` may activate it, and only after
 * the student asks for the refresh.
 */
export function registerPwa(): void {
  if (registrationStarted) {
    return;
  }

  registrationStarted = true;

  updateServiceWorker = registerSW({
    immediate: true,
    onNeedRefresh() {
      needRefresh = true;
      publish();
    },
    onOfflineReady() {
      // Offline readiness is verified by the release PWA journey, not claimed
      // by the shell on the first load.
    },
    onRegisterError() {
      // A failed registration must leave the app usable. No error details or
      // user content are logged or surfaced.
    },
  });
}

/** Marks whether a form currently holds unsaved edits. */
export function setUnsavedChanges(value: boolean): void {
  if (unsavedChanges === value) {
    return;
  }

  unsavedChanges = value;
  publish();
}

export function hasUnsavedChanges(): boolean {
  return unsavedChanges;
}

export function subscribeToUpdatePrompt(listener: UpdatePromptListener): () => void {
  listeners.add(listener);

  return () => {
    listeners.delete(listener);
  };
}

export function getUpdatePromptState(): UpdatePromptState {
  return snapshot;
}

export function dismissUpdate(): void {
  if (!needRefresh) {
    return;
  }

  needRefresh = false;
  publish();
}

/**
 * Activates the waiting service worker only after an explicit confirmation and
 * only while no edit is unsaved.
 */
export async function confirmUpdate(): Promise<boolean> {
  if (!needRefresh || unsavedChanges || updateServiceWorker === null) {
    return false;
  }

  try {
    await updateServiceWorker(true);
    needRefresh = false;
    publish();
    return true;
  } catch {
    // Keep the prompt available when activation fails.
    return false;
  }
}
